Test file: src/claim-office.spec.ts
Activate test: "should cap the policy payout at twice the insurance sum of a single sword"
Current state: 29 tests passing
Implementation file: src/claim-office.ts

Context: this is the FIRST claim test and it must establish claim()'s shape. Design it as follows:

Insurance values: sword 1000, amulet 600, staff 800, potion 400, rune 250, moonstone 250.
Insurance sum = sum of the covered items' insurance values. Cap = 2 x insurance sum.

Signature: claim(items: Item[], incident: Incident, capRemaining: number) returning { payout, remainingCap }, where Incident is { cause: string, damages: { itemType: string, amount: number }[] }. The caller (the CLI) will track capRemaining across successive claims, seeding it with 2 x insurance sum.

For THIS test: a single sword (insurance sum 1000, cap 2000). A damage far above the cap, e.g. amount 5000, should pay out at most the cap: payout 2000, remainingCap 0. (Deductible interacts here — 5000 - 100 = 4900, capped to 2000.)

Activate only this test. claim() is currently a stub returning undefined, so this should genuinely fail.

EXPERIMENT MODE: Run autonomously, proceed to Green after completion.
You MUST output the full Step 7 block verbatim (both Compilation
Prediction and Runtime Prediction lines, each with Correct or
Incorrect). Do not abbreviate. Do not collapse the two prediction
lines into one.
